Seo.Heading: Used Product Exchange in Morocco: How it Works
Seo.Intro: Tekno Store Community is Morocco's premier used product swap and exchange marketplace. Join a vibrant community of readers to trade pre-loved products and novels for free.
Seo.Step1Desc: Upload a photo of your pre-loved product, select its condition (Like New, Good, Used), and your city.
Seo.Step2Desc: Meet readers in public spots across Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, and more.
Seo.Step3Desc: Trade 1-to-1 directly or earn community credits to claim products from any other reader anytime.
Seo.FaqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions about Product Exchange
Seo.FaqQ1: How do I exchange a used product on Tekno Store?
Seo.FaqA1: Create an account on Tekno Store, list the used products from your bookshelf, and browse the market to request a direct swap or trade with credits.
Seo.FaqA2: Yes, exchanging products between community members is 100% free with zero fees. Members meet locally in public spaces.
Seo.FaqQ3: What types of used products can be exchanged?
Seo.FaqA3: All genres are welcome: novels, fiction, manga, self-help, non-fiction, academic and school products in French, Arabic, and English.
Seo.FaqQ4: What if the owner has no product I want?
Seo.FaqA4: Use Tekno Store's credit system: give away your product to earn credits, then redeem them whenever you find a product you like from another reader.

JoinUs.conditionsDescription: Thank you for choosing to contribute your topics to Tekno Store blog. We invite you to read these conditions so your topic can be published:
JoinUs.condition1Title: We do not accept fully copied topics
JoinUs.condition1Desc: Tekno Store blog's policy over the past 31 years has been based on enriching Arabic technical content, therefore we do not accept topics copied entirely from other sites. On the other hand, we accept topics written in your own words even if they come from one or multiple sources.
JoinUs.condition2Title: We do not accept previously covered topics
JoinUs.condition2Desc: Of course, we cannot publish topics that have already been published in order to avoid repetition.
JoinUs.condition3Title: We do not accept topics containing activation codes or software
JoinUs.condition3Desc: At Tekno Store blog, we ensure not to violate intellectual property rights. However, we accept topics containing official activation codes obtained through legal means.
JoinUs.condition4Title: We do not accept poorly written topics
JoinUs.condition4Desc: We all make mistakes, and a few minor errors are fine, but if they make sentences incomprehensible or if there are too many spelling mistakes, it is impossible to publish.
JoinUs.applyDescription: In order to send us your post, please write it in a Word file and send it to the blog via WhatsApp.

ReturnPolicyPage.Section1Desc: In accordance with current legislation, you have a period of <bold>3 calendar days</bold> from the receipt of your order to request an exchange or a return if the product does not suit you.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section2Desc: To be eligible for a return, your product must be in the same condition as when you received it (unread, without marks, creases, or annotations). The original packaging must be kept.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section3Desc: If you receive a damaged product or one with a manufacturing defect, we commit to replacing it free of charge as soon as possible.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section4Desc: To initiate a return, please contact our customer service via WhatsApp or by email at contact@Tekno Store.ma. Please include your order number and photos if the product is defective.
ReturnPolicyPage.Section5Desc: Return shipping is the customer's responsibility and costs <bold>35 MAD</bold>. If the item received is damaged, defective, or incorrect, Tekno Store will replace it at no cost.

ShippingPolicyPage.Title: Shipping Policy
ShippingPolicyPage.Section1Desc: <bold>Tekno Store</bold> delivers to all cities in the Kingdom of Morocco. Whether you are in Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, or more remote areas, we ensure that your products arrive safely.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section2Desc: Our delivery times generally vary between <bold>24h and 48h</bold> working days for major cities. For other regions, the delay can extend up to 4 working days.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section3Desc: Delivery costs are 25 MAD for Casablanca and 35 MAD for other cities. Delivery is free for any order over 300 MAD.
ShippingPolicyPage.Section4Desc: Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a confirmation by SMS or WhatsApp with the necessary information to track the status of your delivery.

PrivacyPage.Title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.Section1Desc: We collect the necessary data to process your orders (name, shipping address, phone number) as well as the information shared via our contact form, our newsletter, or WhatsApp. We also collect anonymized browsing data.
PrivacyPage.Section2Desc: Your information is used for shipping your orders, customer support, and improving our store. We also use this data, with your consent, to personalize your experience and offer you relevant advertisements.
PrivacyPage.Section3Desc: Tekno Store uses cookies, <bold>Google Analytics 4</bold>, and <bold>Google Tag Manager (GTM)</bold> to understand the use of our site, measure our audience, and continuously improve our services.
PrivacyPage.Section4Desc: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting <link>Google Ads Settings</link>.
PrivacyPage.Section5Desc: Data related to your orders is kept for the legal duration necessary for accounting and management purposes. Browsing data and cookies are kept according to current recommendations.
PrivacyPage.Section6Desc: In accordance with data protection laws, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at <contact>contact@Tekno Store.ma</contact>.

CookieBanner.Message: We use cookies to improve your experience on our site and personalize ads. By continuing to browse, you agree to our use of cookies.

TermsPage.Title: Terms and Conditions
TermsPage.Section1Desc: These Terms and Conditions govern all transactions made on the <bold>Tekno Store</bold> website. By using our platform or placing an order, you agree to these terms in full.
TermsPage.Section2Desc: All orders are subject to stock availability. We offer Cash on Delivery (COD). Payment is required at the time the order is handed over to the customer by our delivery service.
TermsPage.Section3Desc: We deliver everywhere in Morocco. Delivery times vary depending on your city and product availability. Tekno Store strives to meet the announced deadlines but is not responsible for delays caused by shipping companies.
TermsPage.Section4Desc: If a received item is defective or non-compliant, you have a period defined in our return policy to contact us. Products must be returned in their original condition.
TermsPage.Section5Desc: All content on the Tekno Store.ma website (texts, images, logos) is protected by copyright. Any unauthorized reproduction is strictly prohibited.
TermsPage.Section6Desc: Tekno Store reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication on the site. We encourage you to review this page regularly.

Livraison1hRabatPage.H1: 1-Hour Product Delivery in Rabat, Sale, Temara
Livraison1hRabatPage.P1: Got a sudden urge to read? Looking for the perfect last-minute gift? Tekno Store introduces Sonic, Morocco's first ultra-fast product delivery service. Now, receive your favorite novels, essays, and textbooks in under an hour.
Livraison1hRabatPage.P2: Our exclusive service currently covers Rabat, Sale, and Temara. No more waiting days: thanks to our optimized network of delivery partners and our logistics hub located in the heart of the capital, culture comes to you at lightning speed.
Livraison1hRabatPage.P3: How does it work? It's simple! Browse our complete catalog of Sonic-eligible products below. All these titles are in stock and ready to ship instantly. Confirm your order with the Sonic delivery option, and relax. Your next product is already on its way.
Livraison1hRabatPage.CatalogTitle: Our entire catalog in immediate delivery
Livraison1hRabatPage.CatalogDesc: Thousands of products in stock. Order now, read in 1 hour.
Livraison1hRabatPage.Empty: No products available for Sonic delivery at the moment.
